I am a licensed wildlife rehabber that specializes in small mammals and fawns. I do not work with RVS (rabies vector species so coyotes, skunks, raccoons, bats, etc…) THESE ARE NOT PETS. All animals that come into my care will be released as soon as they are old enough and healthy enough the do so. Wildlife should stay wild they are not pets and should not be deprived of the life they were born to live.
